question: In January 2023, Captain Shiva Chouhan was in the news for being the first women officer to be deployed at which battlefield?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2) Siachen**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Captain Shiva Chouhan** made history by becoming the first woman officer to be deployed at the **Siachen Glacier**, the world's highest and coldest battlefield.
 
• Her deployment marks a significant milestone in the Indian Army, showcasing the increasing role of women in combat roles and high-altitude postings.
 
• The Siachen Glacier is located in the eastern Karakoram range in the Himalayas, just northeast of the point where the Line of Control between India and Pakistan ends.
 
• This deployment is part of the Indian Army's ongoing efforts to enhance gender inclusivity and empower women officers by providing them with challenging and prestigious assignments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Siachen Glacier** is approximately 76 km long and is located at an average altitude of 5,400 meters (17,700 feet).
 
• The region is known for its extreme weather conditions, with temperatures dropping to as low as -60 degrees Celsius in winter.
 
• Since 1984, India and Pakistan have maintained a permanent military presence in the region, making it one of the most challenging and strategic military posts in the world.
 
• Captain Chouhan's deployment is a testament to the evolving dynamics of the Indian Army and its commitment to providing equal opportunities for all its personnel, regardless of gender.
